newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLAIPEDOS NAFTA HANDLES 1.1 MLN TONNES IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: KLAIPEDOS NAFTA HANDLES 1.1 MLN TONNES IN MAY.

text.p: Lithuania's Klaipedos Nafta said on Friday it handled 1.104 million tonnes of oil products in the first five months of the year and 189,000 tonnes in May compared to 145,000 tonnes in April.
"We were disapointed with the reloading volumes in April and in May since we expected it to be considerably higher," Elena Chernij, finance manager of the company, told Reuters.
Last month the company said it was expecting to reload three times more than in April.
"The first days of June showed that we might expect that the company will handle more oil products than in May," Chernij added.
The company is doing reconstruction works worth $120 million, expected to be ended in the first quarter of 1998.
State-run Naftos Terminalas listed on the A group of Vilnius bourse owns 46 percent of Klaipedos Nafta.
